text:
zoe: Quick idea  Sunset bonfire + s'mores + acoustic jam on the plaza next Thursday? 6pm onwards, casual. bring blankets if you want. :fire::marshmallow:

matt: YES. i'll bring a travel guitar. :guitar:

olivia: sounds lovely. can we have a non-alcoholic option and keep it family-friendly? bringing my partner.

carmen: i'm in. any rules about fires/permits?

zoe: good q  pinging facilities to confirm permits and safety. also thinking a small budget for marshmallows/chocolate/graham crackers. react with :one: if you're in, :two: if maybe.

leo: in. :one:

matt: :one:

facilities: Hey! Plaza bonfires require a one-day permit and a safety steward. We can book steward through facilities for $75. Also need a portable firepit. If you want the plaza reserved, submit request at least 72hrs ahead.

zoe: thanks! i'll submit. @events-bot can you block the plaza 6-9pm?

events-bot: Block request received. Please confirm headcount and steward approval to finalize. Use `/event reserve --space plaza --start 18:00 --end 21:00 --notes "bonfire & s'mores"`.

olivia: RSVP +1 (bringing partner). also allergic to nuts, heads up.

carmen: RSVP. i can bring vegan marshmallows.

matt: i'll bring power bank and extra guitar picks. also can bring a small amp if there's consent.

zoe: added a one-question RSVP sheet: https://tiny.redwood/bonfire-rsvp  add dietary/allergy notes and gear offers. closing Wed noon.

leo: quick accessibility note  plaza has one ramped access but cobbles are a bit uneven. can facilities provide a folding mat for smoother path?

facilities: Yes, we can provide a 10ft folding mat and staff to assist setup. DM for logistics.

carmen: budget q  how much per person to cover snacks? happy to split.

zoe: thinking $10 suggested donation to cover supplies + steward. if anyone needs a subsidy DM me.

finance-bot: For pooled expenditures, submit `/expense submit --amount <total> --category team-socials --notes "bonfire supplies"`. Finance will reimburse up to approved event cap.

matt: tiny concern  some of us prefer no open flames. can we have a battery-powered LED lantern area as an option?

zoe: yes good call. will set up a non-flame chill zone with battery lanterns.

olivia: also: can we have a brief noise check? neighbors might be around. maybe keep acoustic level low after 8:30.

zoe: agreed. plan: unplugged acoustic until 8:30, then quiet jam. I'll note in the event page.

carmen: volunteers for cleanup? react with :broom: if you can stay 15 min after to tidy.

leo: :broom:

matt: :broom: happy to help.

zoe: Awesome. Final checklist: submit permit + steward (me), RSVP sheet (link above), buy supplies ($10 suggested), volunteers for setup/cleanup. See you Thursday  bring blankets and good vibes! :sparkles:
